name: Opportunity Map
tagline: See the projects forming in your markets before they reach a tender, ranked by how well they fit.
problem: Pursuit teams find projects late, from tenders, after the best positions are taken.
how: Market signals: plans, queues, permits, financing
Ranks forming projects by fit, then tests each against the six constraints that set the delivery date
A pursuit list with the evidence, the earliest credible date and the next action for each
features: Opportunity signals: Resource plans, queues, permits, financing and offtake, tracked across markets
Fit ranking: Each opportunity scored against your criteria, with the evidence behind the score
Delivery and contractor intelligence: Contractor backlog, workforce and lead times for major equipment
Alerts and next actions: What changed, and who should act on it
Build Advisor: Six delivery constraints, each with a verdict, a date effect and its source: turbine slots, transformers, contractor backlog, craft labor, interconnection, gas supply
Pursuit case: A pursuit case and delivery plan generated for each shortlisted project

screens.title: Tracked clients
screens.caption: The directory of 76 clients and organisations the map watches for project signals.

screens.title: Project profiles
screens.caption: Key projects with a profile for each: stage, capacity, planned and actual cost, dates and delay.

screens.title: Build advisor
screens.caption: Picks the best-fit delivery model for a planned build from industry, region, size and priorities, with Yard experience alongside.

screens.caption: How each delivery model has performed in the Yard: number of projects, median cost against plan and median delay.

notes: Captured from the running Project Intelligence Toolkit with its seeded demo data. Ranked signals and the research view are not shown: they need a search provider and a model key, which this local run does not have.
